pairs: Puer autem Samuel ministrabat Domino coram Heli,
Now the boy Samuel was ministering to the Lord before Eli,
et sermo Domini erat pretiosus in diebus illis:
and the word of the Lord was precious in those days;
Factum est ergo in die quadam,
Then it happened that, on a certain day,
Eli was lying in his place.
et oculi ejus caligaverant, nec poterat videre:
And his eyes had dimmed, so that he was unable to see.
And so, to prevent the lamp of God from going out,
Samuel was sleeping in the temple of the Lord,
where the ark of God was.
Et adjecit Dominus rursum vocare Samuelem.
the Lord continued to call to Samuel.
Now Samuel did not yet know the Lord,
neque revelatus fuerat ei sermo Domini.
and the word of the Lord had not been revealed to him.
and he called to Samuel still a third time.
And rising up, he went to Eli.
Intellexit ergo Heli quia Dominus vocaret puerum:
Then Eli understood that the Lord had called the boy.
And if he calls to you from now on,
and he slept in his place.
just as he had called the other times,
And the Lord said to Samuel: “Behold,
Ecce ego facio verbum in Israël,
I am accomplishing a word in Israel.
In die illa suscitabo adversum Heli omnia quæ locutus sum super domum ejus:
In that day, I will raise up against Eli all the things that I have spoken over his house.
Prædixi enim ei quod judicaturus essem domum ejus in æternum propter iniquitatem,
For I have foretold to him that I will judge his house unto eternity, because of iniquity.
eo quod noverat indigne agere filios suos,
For he had known that his sons acted shamefully,
and he did not chastise them.
Idcirco juravi domui Heli quod non expietur iniquitas domus ejus victimis et muneribus usque in æternum.
For this reason, I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of his house will not be expiated, with victims or with gifts, even forever.”
and he opened the doors of the house of the Lord.
Et Samuel timebat indicare visionem Heli.
And Samuel was afraid to tell the vision to Eli.
Quis est sermo, quem locutus est Dominus ad te?
“What is the word that the Lord has spoken to you?
I beg you that you may not conceal it from me.
May God do these things to you,
et hæc addat, si absconderis a me sermonem ex omnibus verbis quæ dicta sunt tibi.
and may he add these other things, if you hide from me one word out of all the things that were told to you.”
Indicavit itaque ei Samuel universos sermones,
And so, Samuel revealed to him all the words,
and he did not hide them from him.
quod bonum est in oculis suis faciat.
May he do what is good in his own eyes.”
and the Lord was with him,
et non cecidit ex omnibus verbis ejus in terram.
and not one of his words fell to the ground.
quod fidelis Samuel propheta esset Domini.
knew Samuel to be a faithful prophet of the Lord.
Et addidit Dominus ut appareret in Silo,
And the Lord continued to appear in Shiloh.
quoniam revelatus fuerat Dominus Samueli in Silo juxta verbum Domini.
For the Lord had revealed himself to Samuel at Shiloh, according to the word of the Lord.
Et evenit sermo Samuelis universo Israëli.
And the word about Samuel went forth to all of Israel.
